title: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list each ACTIVE network
question: For tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list each ACTIVE network (network ID, network name, tenant ID, admin_state_up, MTU, and the network standard-attribute updated_at timestamp) along with its row number within the tenant (ordered by network name), the total number of ACTIVE networks for that tenant and the average ACTIVE-network count across tenants; and for ports on those networks that are administratively up and have at least one IP allocation, also show the port ID, MAC address, the port’s IP allocation count, the number of distinct subnets for those allocations, and the deviation of that port’s allocation count from the average across such ports. Do not return any rounded answers.
